Module: **FQHE** · directory: `FQHE/src/FQHEOnSphere` · binary: `FQHE/src/Programs/FQHEOnSphere/FQHESphereWithSpinMonteCarlo`

```text
FQHESphereWithSpinMonteCarlo, version 0.01

Usage: FQHESphereWithSpinMonteCarlo [options] 

Options:

system options:
    -p, --nbr-particles : number of particles (default value = 6)

    --spacing-D : spacing of layer separation d where the energy is evaluated (value must be greater than 0, default value = 0.25)
    -n, --nbr-D : number of layer separation d where the energy is evaluated (default value = 13)
    --all-params : File containing all parameters of the interaction
    --params-inter : File containing parameters of inter-spin interaction
    --params-intra : File containing parameters of intra-spin interaction
    --params-other : File containing parameters of second intra-spin interaction for down spins (if different from up channel)
    --list-wavefunctions : list all available test wave fuctions
    --list-samplingfunctions : list all available sampling-fuctions
    -b, --background-only : print background energy, and exit
    
    -o, --output : file to write a log of results (and a separate correlation function)

Monte-Carlo options:
    -i, --nbr-iter : number of Monte Carlo iterations (default value = 10000)
    -d, --sample-density : number of Monte Carlo microsteps between iterations (-1=NbrParticles) (default value = -1)
    --thermalize : number of microsteps used for thermalization (default value = 2500)
    --nbr-display : number of intermediate results displayed (default value = 10)
    --randomSeed : random seed for internal random number generator (default value = -1)

analytical wave function options:
    --test-wavefunction : name of the test wave fuction
    --nbr-flux : number of quantum flux attached to each particle (laughlin and *cf only) (value must be greater than 0, default value = 1)
    --cluster-size : number of particles per cluster (read only) (value must be greater than 2, default value = 3)
    --nbr-level : number of pseudo Landau levels (filledcf only) (value must be greater than 1, default value = 1)
    --cf-file : name of the file describing the composite fermion state (genericcf only)
    --bosons : coefficient for boson contribution (pairedcfcb only) (default value = 1)
    --MR-coeff : coefficient for Moore-Read contribution (pairedcf only) (default value = 1)
    --pair-coeff : sequence of pairing coefficients (pairedcfp only)
    --pair-wave : choose pairing channel s,+p,... (pairedcf* only) (default value = 1)
    --pair-compatibility : adopt old conventions for normalisation (pairedcf* only)
    --jastrow-inside : move jastrow factors inside determinant (1s only)
    --XHC : coefficients (k,l,p,q,r,s,t,u,v,b) of extended Halperin wavefunction  (XH only)
    --antisymmetrize : antisymmetrize wavefunction (XH only)
    --partonShells : number of shells for parton & effective flux: lFup,lFdown,N_phi^eff
    --fermion-state : generate a fermionic wavefunction (nass)

sampling function options:
    --list-sampling-functions : list all available sampling fuctions
    --sampler : name of the test wave fuction
    --laughlin-exponent : power to which the jastrow factors in sampling function are raised (default value = 2)
    --SHC : coefficients (k,l,m) of sampling Halperin wavefunction

misc options:

global options:
```
